Programme Outline

Awarded and developed by: The University of Sydney, Australia

The Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) programme is accredited by the Singapore Nursing Board.

The Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) programme is a two-year research degree programme, comprising 2 study units and a thesis. It is designed to equip you with the readiness to undertake research and potentially progress to doctoral studies and a research career.

Throughout the programme you will be introduced to a variety of research perspectives. You will work with research supervisor(s) to develop both the theoretical  and practical components of your individual honours project.

Learning Outcomes

Upon successful completion of this programme, you will:

  1. Gain comprehensive overview of contemporary research philosophy and methodologies
  2. Enhance your knowledge of ethical considerations, research design, data collection, data management and analysis
  3. Develop further your skills for comprehensively searching, reviewing and critiquing research literature; constructing a concise thesis argument; and presenting your findings to peers
  4. Be familiar with higher degree research studies and research in a clinical setting

Further Studies & Career Prospects

Graduates are eligible to apply and gain entry to a PhD.

The research training is a valuable asset for any nurse because of the emphasis on evidence-based nursing. It may be seen as an advantage for gaining promotion. Graduates may also have the option to undertake a research career.

Why study at SIM x The University of Sydney

SIM is the leading private education institution in Singapore.
Excellent value with lower tuition costs in SIM, with opportunities for overseas exchange and transfer.
Ranked 1st in Australia and 14th in the world for university nursing education and research excellence (QS World University Rankings by Subject 2024)
Also ranked 1st in Australia and 4th in the world for Graduate Employability. (QS Graduate Employability Rankings 2020)
Learn more about The University of Sydney

Intake Dates

Jan 2027 intake

PROGRAMME DURATION

Jan 2027 to Dec 2028

APPLICATION PERIOD

04 Jul 2026 to 15 Jan 2027

Students enrolled in the Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) offshore in Singapore may only enrol part-time in order to meet Singapore Nursing Board requirements for their research projects.

The maximum allowed period to complete is within 2 to 3 years of first enrolment.

  • Students who did not complete in the maximum period of candidature may apply for extension.
  • Students may be granted a suspension of candidature in certain circumstances.
  • Students who fail to complete the programme within the candidature period are not entitled to any recourse or refund.

Curriculum

Structure

  • The mode of delivery is blended learning, comprising:
    • On-campus research workshops*
    • Individual research supervision meetings
    • E-Learning^
    • Duration of class is dependent on the needs of the lesson (ranges from 1 -3 hours per lesson).
  • The programme is fully taught by The University of Sydney Susan Wakil School of Nursing and Midwifery academics
    View a list of lecturers’ teaching modules (PDF 409 KB)
  • Average teacher-student ratio 1:2
  • There is no minimum class size because this degree is based on individual research.
 

*Students are required to attend a 5-day research theory workshop which is held at The University of Sydney’ Susan Wakill School of Nursing and Midwifery, Australia as part of their candidature.

^Students will have access to the Sydney eLearning platform as well as the Research Hub, which is a shared online space for all research degree students at Susan Wakill School of Nursing and Midwifery.

Show more Show less

Assessment & Attendance

Students are required to complete 3 assessment components:

  1. Research seminar presentation (10%)
  2. Literature review of 5,000-6,000 words (10%)
  3. 15,000-word thesis (80%)

Requirements to Graduate

  • This is a research degree and students are allocated a supervisor. 
  • Students who successfully complete all academic requirements of the programme will be awarded the Bachelor of Nursing (Honours) by the The University of Sydney, Australia.
  • A degree conferral ceremony will be held in Singapore.

Admission Criteria

Accepted Entry Qualifications

The following qualifications are accepted:

  • Bachelor of Nursing by the University of Sydney; OR
  • Equivalent qualifications from other universities with a minimum Weighted Average Mark (WAM) of 65

Applicants must also:

  • Possess current registration as a registered nurse in Australia or a country other than Australia; AND
  • Meet satisfaction of English language proficiency requirements as detailed in the University of Sydney's Coursework Policy


Notes

  1. Applicants will be assessed based on their qualifications submitted. Qualifications used must have been completed less than 10 years prior to application. 
    • Qualifications older than 10 years will be considered subject to the applicant providing further information substantiating appropriate continuing education and development. In these cases, admission will be at the discretion of the Dean.
  2. Entry will be on a case-by-case basis; however, a minimum grade point average (GPA) of 3.25 or 65% (credit average) will be the benchmark for admission.
  3. Students are required to provide a brief research proposal when they submit their application.
  4. No exemptions allowed.

Programme Fees

Fee per module: S$5,995

Total programme fee: S$23,980 payable for 4 modules, over 4 semesters
 

  • Fees quoted are valid for the intake for the current application. For subsequent intakes, please visit this page nearer to the application period for updated information.
  • Above fees exclude textbooks, repeat fees of failed module, airfare and accommodation expenses. Not all modules may be offered in every semester.
  • First term semester payable upon acceptance of offer. Subsequent term semester payable before commencement of the semester.
  • All fees inclusive of prevailing GST.

Mandatory One-time Fees

All fees inclusive of prevailing GST.

Application Fee

Payable for each application form that is submitted. Fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. The fee will be refunded fully only if the intake does not commence. Unpaid applications will not be processed.

2027 University of Sydney Nursing Talent Development Fund
Nurses make up the largest professional group of healthcare workers in Singapore* and play an essential role in patients' care at all levels. It is crucial to recognise the value of nurses and invest in them to create more opportunities for them to upgrade their skills and practise at a higher level.

The University is committed to improving learning access and support for nurses in Singapore. Deepen your knowledge and boost your career mobility with an SNB-accredited degree. Commence your nursing degree studies at SIM and get 10% off total programme fees.
